footprint.symmetry: mostly symmetrical on front/back axis, asymmetry added by the corner tower

raw_elements: continuous horizontal window strips on each floor (long rows of glass panes)
entrance centered at ground level (small recessed doorway visible)
stepped dark roof forming a raised perimeter with inner hollow courtyard
corner vertical tower/chimney rising above roofline
glowstone blocks used as small exterior lights
raw_hints: Build a rectangular outer shell ~13x13 blocks with an inner hollow courtyard (roughly centered) leaving a 3-4 block wide wall around the courtyard.
Use stonebrick for the external wall; add continuous 1-block-high glass bands for windows on each of three levels separated by 1-block stone slab ledges.
Construct a dark brick (nether-brick) stepped roof that sits on top perimeter and steps up toward center; add a small rectangular chimney/tower on one corner rising 3-4 blocks above the roof.
Place glowstone accents near lower-floor corners where shown and a small recessed entrance centered on the front wall with a short stair or slab.
rebuild_intent.summary: A small three-story rectangular building with thick stone-like walls, continuous horizontal bands of windows on each floor, a dark stepped hip/gable-like roof and a small rectangular chimney/tower attached to one corner. The structure surrounds a hollow interior courtyard/open well visible from top-down views.
